alt: Eine Bengalkatze reibt ihre Wange an der entspannten Hand einer lesenden Frau auf dem Sofa.
prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create one landscape 3:2 editorial photograph for a German Bengal cat magazine. Cat is main subject, woman partly framed from shoulders down so no posed smiling face. Clearly authentic Bengal rosettes, normal domestic cat proportions, believable joints, paws and whiskers. Slightly imperfect everyday room with one folded blanket and book; background softly legible, not a showroom. Neutral overcast window daylight, accurate muted colors, visible natural skin and fabric texture. No warm amber filter, no beauty smoothing, no dramatic rim light, no excessively shallow depth, no posing, no hugging or lifting cat, no text, no logo, no watermark. This is a new scene, not an edit of the prior artificial portrait.
